title: Are Sardines Unsafe Due to Mercury?

scenes.text: Do the tiny sardines you snack on contain dangerous mercury levels?
A common belief is that all small oily fish, like sardines, are high in mercury.
scenes.label: Sardines high mercury

scenes.text: Research shows sardines are low in mercury because they are low on the food chain; they provide omega‑3s with minimal contaminant risk.
scenes.label: Low mercury, high omega‑3

scenes.text: Enjoy a serving a few times a week for heart health.
scenes.label: Heart‑healthy snack

scenes.text: Follow for simple habits that boost your health.

description: Worried that sardines might poison you with mercury? Science says they're actually one of the safest omega‑3 sources. Stay informed and keep snacking smart. Follow for more evidence‑based health tips.
